author: Da_Baus
body:
Hello Avicus staff
I would like to appeal my ban for hacking (Kill aura).
Firstly I had made a lot of great friends on avicus and I feel like I have let them down and I should have just played legitimately and now I feel like a fool.
Secondly I would really like to get back to this server and play with all the new community and make new friends.
Finally I have really felt bad about what I have done because I know the time and effort that the community as a whole puts in and I have just wasted your time. I have ban evaded but it was because I was so addicted to avicus when I got banned I had to play but now I realised what I had done and I feel silly because I'm not like that. It would mean the world to me if I could get unbanned

-CounterStrafes

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You won't be appealed as you are responsible for what you do. This whole 'I am sorry' talk won't help, because at the end of the day, you hacked.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
